limits: Single host with two real processes and explicit stdin/stdout command acknowledgments; no sleeps or elapsed-time assertions.
Busy callback returns zero immediately; observed invocation counts are specific to this defined lock event.
Shared-cache notification covers one blocking writer and one blocked reader, no deadlock cycles or grouped multiple waiters.
Callbacks record fixed native context only, invoke no SQLite API and contain all exceptions.
Two threads use separate FULLMUTEX/private-cache connections and three read rounds with explicit barriers/joins; no writes or shared connection use.
Failure injection, interrupted processes, custom VFS, prolonged contention, cancellation races and broader provider/thread contracts remain separate.
